input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. Keep head and torso aimed upper-right away from viewer. Never turn to face the viewer. Raw magical low lean canine made of charcoal-black cracked stone hide, ember seams, angular pointed ears, long jointed legs, compact flame tail. Four legs and distinct lean hound muzzle; no gore. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly TWO columns by THREE rows, SIX complete poses. Six resistance poses: ready, lower body braces, forelimbs plant or moth wings fold forward, body withstands force, small effort variation, steady braced hold. No injury or collapse, no shield object or magic effect added to an animal.All complete bodies same anatomical scale, very wide empty magenta gutters. No labels, no text, no anatomy outside its cell. No falling or resting poses. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. CORRECTION: Exactly TWO columns by THREE rows, six SMALL rear hounds. Each complete hound is centered and occupies only HALF of its cell width and height. Very large completely empty magenta gutters on all sides. No touching or overlapping tails, feet or bodies. Six low braced resistance poses with front paws planted widely and torso leaning against pressure, small effort variations, all rear-right view. Keep the whole torso and all paws visible. Do not show a return to an upright casual standing pose in the last four keys.

arguments.Prompt: Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy game character ANIMATION SHEET on a uniform vivid solid MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Grid layout: Exactly 2 columns by 3 rows, containing exactly 6 complete poses in a clean 2x3 grid. Very wide completely empty solid magenta #FF00FF gutters between and around every cell. Each complete hound is centered and occupies only half of its cell width and height, leaving generous empty magenta space around it. No touching or overlapping tails, feet, or bodies. No borders, grid lines, text, numbers, or labels. Subject: Cinder hound, an animal-only magical creature. Raw magical low lean canine made of charcoal-black cracked stone hide with glowing ember seams, angular pointed ears, long jointed legs, and a compact flame tail. Four legs and distinct lean hound muzzle. Animal only, no human features, no clothing, no weapons, no shields, no gore. View and Angle: For ALL 6 poses, REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view (northeast / upper-right facing away from camera). Camera sees BACK surfaces; head and torso are aimed diagonally away from viewer and toward image upper-right. Camera elevated at 55-degree orthographic angle, not eye-level. Consistent rear-right 3/4 perspective across all 6 poses; never turning to face the viewer. Poses: Six resistance and defense poses with front paws planted widely and torso leaning against pressure, small effort variations, all rear-right view. 1. Low ready stance bracing against oncoming force. 2. Lower body lowers and braces deep, forelimbs planting firmly. 3. Forelimbs plant widely, torso tensed and leaning into pressure. 4. Body withstands heavy force, back arched with muscles and stone plates locked. 5. Small effort variation, digging claws in and absorbing pressure. 6. Steady braced hold, enduring sustained pressure with front paws wide and torso leaning against force. Keep the whole torso and all paws visible. Identical anatomical scale across all 6 figures. Style: Stylized hand-painted dark fantasy concept art matching Reference-1 and Reference-2. Sculpted painterly volume, smooth opaque paint, lighter stylized painted values, simple sculpted rock shapes with warm ember glow in cracks, subtle cool upper-left lighting highlights, small contact shadows directly beneath paws onto magenta. No grain, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism, or 3D render.
